secretHandling.officialCli: The upstream CLI currently accepts App Secret via -s/--app-secret arguments.
secretHandling.risk: The upstream child process still receives the secret as an argument and trusted local process inspection may reveal it.
secretHandling.requiredMitigation: Codex config forwards only process environment variable names to the local wrapper. The wrapper never logs values, validates the locked package metadata and JavaScript entrypoint, invokes Node directly instead of a cmd.exe shim, and refuses to enable the server if credentials or package files are absent.
secretHandling.publicTemplateRule: The public template contains placeholders and environment variable names only and remains disabled.

servers.name: 统一媒体生成 MCP
servers.purpose: 统一图片/视频 MCP。Image-2 自动使用签名 U 盘授权中的 404token Key，经 Responses API 生成并保存图片；Grok、Seedance，以及未来由统一上游开放后的 MiniMax 仍共用这条授权与 MCP。MiniMax 模型槽位默认留空，不会回退到其他模型。

healthCheck.expected: Version 1.3.11: local runtime/protocol health includes initialize, tools/list, and media_capabilities over UTF-8 raw bytes under a simulated non-UTF-8 Python environment; capabilities report the 600-second internal HTTP timeout. Grok video exposes explicit first_frame/reference roles; xAI-compatible reference_images payloads are accepted only for certified model/profile combinations, and live generation remains a separate capability check. Model IDs must match the explicitly configured provider model and a current 24-hour gateway catalog; refresh is read-only and does not prove generation capability. Same-intent unknown submissions are never replayed automatically. Errors use a structured, redacted JSON envelope; asynchronous task completion and local artifact saving are separate states with MIME/signature/hash checks. Codex allows 1500 seconds for the whole media tool call. The kit wrapper reads the runtime credential from its process environment or current-user DPAPI; it never places the key in Codex config or logs. After installation, restart Codex to reload the stdio server.
healthCheck.failure: 本地 Python 或 MCP 未通过检查时安装失败；缺少有效 U 盘授权时，不访问上游。
